$comment: DORMANT since the v2 upgrade (PR #180): nothing reads this file. The v1 consumers — rsbuild.config.ts (injected COMPONENTS_REMOTE_* defines) and hydrate.tsx/router.server.tsx (called loadFederatedComponents) — were all deleted by the upgrade, and the generated hydrate.gen.tsx stub has no remotes seam. The loader (ui/src/lib/load-federated-components.ts) is kept as dormant reference code. First-class support is proposed upstream: everything-dev#460. Until that lands, every federated() wrapper resolves to its local fallback and this file only records the intended wiring. Original motivation: Module Federation remotes this app consumes at runtime (#55).

components.$comment: nearbuilders.org's UI Module Federation remote (name: 'ui'), exposing './components' — the design-system barrel this app federates in (#56/#57). 'development' assumes nearbuilders.org's own UI dev server is running locally (port-collision note: both UI dev servers default to the same port — run theirs with a PORT override, e.g. PORT=3010). 'production' is nearbuilders.org's live custom domain; 'integrity' is the SRI hash of its current remoteEntry.js — recompute with computeSriHashForUrl from everything-dev/integrity on every redeploy over there, until everything-dev#460 (or nearbuilders.org#260) gives this a recorded, publish-time value like app.ui.integrity gets for this app's own UI.
